Create one finished portfolio project artwork for TYSHA, not a webpage. Canvas 1536x1344 px (8:7). A calm high-end product design portfolio composition, coordinated with minimal white website. NO external headline, logo, text labels, watermark or marketing copy. Use the attached authentic Tysha app screenshots as exact references. First source is the live sound mixer with green washing-machine, pink heart, blue fan and rain sound bubbles; second is the same screen with Sleep timer bottom sheet. Preserve these actual UI contents and hierarchy, do not invent features or numbers. Composition: one full slim graphite iPhone in the center-left showing the mixer, standing nearly front-facing, with a slight 5 degree clockwise lean; beside it on the right a smaller flat floating crop of ONLY the Sleep timer panel from second image, clearly readable, not a second full phone. Very restrained layered screen study. Main phone takes about 76% image height, full silhouette is contained, 110px safe margins; timer panel occupies 32% canvas width and sits at center-right with minimal overlap over phone's empty edge, never covering the sound controls. Flat pale oatmeal backdrop #eee7db with broad soft daylight and subtle short diffused shadows. No copper room, no arches, no pedestal, no props, no decorative 3D balls, no glow. Let the black screen and small muted sound colors be the visual focus. The background is matte and barely textured like fine paper. The product artwork should look precise, welcoming and quiet. Retain exact words 'Unsaved mix', 'Playing', 'Save room', 'Sleep timer', '15 min', '30 min', '45 min', '60 min', 'Till morning' where shown.
